title: 第21章 我成了供她们采补的炉鼎第22章 双修成了我的职业好好干
content_zh:
最后一刻我才懂，所谓的回光返照，是菁琎牺牲了自己，只想让我再多看这个世界一眼！
除了36条大长腿，我又看到18张绝美容颜，正朝着我飘过来。
18胞胎？
这真的是回光返照吗？
不，我终于进入了梦境！
梦境里空无一物，只有我和18胞胎，**裸地漂浮在虚空之中。
她们围着我，满面春光，那眼神，我懂。
我细细分辨，她们长得一模一样。
这种极致对称的美，狠狠挑动着我的心弦。
我知道，只有闭上眼睛伸手触摸，才能一一将她们区分开。
但我更想让这份心弦的震颤，再猛烈些。
“♂♂，♀??！”
她们异口同声地说着什么。
可我听不懂，只能清晰感觉到她们眼底的渴望。
这是我的梦，怎么会听不懂她们的话？
“你们是谁？”
她们笑而不语。
我已经两年多没进入过梦境，或许这根本不是梦，只是我的执念。
我本想以“双修”证道，去征服这个宇宙。
没想到，第一步就卡在了这里。

我已经走到了终结的边缘，眼前的一切，不过是我的执念罢了！
言语本就是多余的，不如用指尖去感受，让心弦震颤到极致。
哎呀，“肾力”不足！
那就用时间来弥补。
终于，18胞胎为我的证道之途，添上了18个“学分”。
我累得眼花了？18胞胎一眨眼竟变成了36胞胎。
不对，是两组18胞胎。
新的18胞胎同样笑而不语，是在嘲笑我的“肾力”不济吗？
只要功夫深，执念总能实现。
终于，在血泪交织间，我遂了她们的心愿。
恍惚间，36胞胎又变成了72胞胎。
不对，是四组18胞胎。
好吧，这是在考验我对执念的信念。
有信念加持，72胞胎助我在征程上迈出了最坚实的一步。
我知道，这只是开始，因为72胞胎已经变成了144胞胎。
不对，是八组18胞胎。
奇怪了，最后一组18胞胎，居然是森林里遇到的那18位女战神！
绝对不会错，她们腹部的胎记，和我记忆中一模一样。
我下意识后退两步，她们一口气就能把我吹成虚无。
可我已经被她们团团包围，无路可退，只能持续前行。
content_en:
Only at the last moment did I understand that the so-called reflection was because Jingjin sacrificed herself, just to let me see the world one more time!
In addition to the 36 long legs, I saw 18 stunning faces floating towards me.
18 babies?
Is this really a throwback?
No, I finally entered a dream!
There was nothing in the dream, only the 18th twins and I, floating naked in the void.
They surrounded me, their faces were full of joy, and I understood that look.
I noticed carefully that they looked exactly the same.
The beauty of this extreme symmetry really stirred my heartstrings.
I know that only by closing my eyes and reaching out to touch can I distinguish them one by one.
But I want this heartstrings to tremble more violently.
"♂♂,♀??!"
They were saying something in unison.
But I couldn't understand, I could only clearly feel the desire in their eyes.
This is my dream, how can I not understand what they are saying?
"Who are you?"
They laughed but said nothing.
I haven't entered a dream for more than two years. Maybe this is not a dream at all, but just my obsession.
I originally wanted to achieve enlightenment through "double cultivation" and conquer this universe.
Unexpectedly, I got stuck here in the first step.
I have reached the edge of the end, everything in front of me is just my obsession!
Words are superfluous, it is better to feel it with your fingertips and let your heart strings tremble to the extreme.
Oops, not enough "kidney power"!
Then use time to make up for it.
Finally, having 18 babies added 18 "credits" to my path to enlightenment.
Am I so tired that I feel dizzy? The 18th twins turned into 36th twins in the blink of an eye.
No, it's two sets of 18 babies.
The new 18-borns also laughed and said nothing. Are they laughing at my poor "kidney power"?
As long as you work hard, obsession can always be realized.
Finally, amid the intertwining of blood and tears, I fulfilled their wish.
Suddenly, the 36th baby turned into the 72nd baby.
No, it's four sets of 18 babies.
Well, this is testing my faith in obsession.
With the blessing of faith, the 72nd twins helped me take the most solid step on my journey.
I know this is just the beginning, because the 72 births have turned into 144 births.
No, it's eight sets of 18 babies.
Strangely enough, the last group of 18 babies were actually the 18 female war goddesses we met in the forest!
There is absolutely no mistake, the birthmarks on their abdomens are exactly the same as in my memory.
I subconsciously took two steps back, and they could blow me into nothingness in one breath.
But I was already surrounded by them and had no way to retreat but to keep moving forward.
